title: Approvals badge in the Pods app
goal: Keep grants at the IdP: the Pods app only shows how many are waiting and opens the IdP grants page.
summary: The inbox decision list keeps only Pods decisions. A separate Approvals entry shows the number of all grants waiting for the owner at the IdP and opens id.openape.ai/grants; the app icon badge includes it. Each Pod gate keeps one open approval batch at the IdP that grows with new items for up to seven days, so the owner reviews and confirms one batch instead of many; an expired batch reopens automatically.

problem.statement: Approval batches expire after 12 hours; the inbox then keeps an item whose IdP link points to an expired grant. IdP approvals are mixed into the Pods decision list.
problem.impact: The owner sees approvals that cannot be confirmed, and the blocked mails wait until someone requests a fresh approval in Pods.
problem.approach: Keep one growing batch per gate, reopen it when it expires, count the owner's pending grants at the IdP from the desktop, and show that count as one Approvals entry linking to the IdP.
problem.outcome: Decisions are made in Pods, grants at the IdP; the app shows one current count and never a dead link.

milestones.title: One growing batch per gate
milestones.goal: Each Pod gate keeps one open IdP batch that new items join until the owner decides it.
acceptance: While a batch is pending, new gate items are appended to it as members without an announced size (grants.md §3.4), up to 100 items; the 2-minute quiet window and the 30-item limit go away.

A batch waits up to seven days; when it expires with nothing released or consumed, its items reopen automatically as a new batch. A batch with a released, consumed or uncertain item is never renewed automatically.
The owner's decision covers exactly the items shown; approved items run, denied ones are dropped, and items that arrive afterwards start the next batch.
The batches already blocked by expiry, 7552ebfa and 2ae211d1, rejoin the open batch once after the update.
milestones.rollback: Install the previous signed build from the paired backup.

milestones.title: Count pending grants at the IdP
milestones.goal: The desktop reads the owner's pending grants with the existing apes login and publishes only their number to the relay.
acceptance: The count equals apes grants inbox: pending grants of others for the owner; a batch counts once.
Pods only reads the apes login, never writes, renews with a refresh token or logs out; without a login the count is marked unknown instead of zero.
The relay stores the count per owner and includes it in the app badge.
milestones.rollback: Stop publishing the count; the relay ignores a missing count.

milestones.title: Approvals entry in the inbox
milestones.goal: The PWA shows Approvals separately from decisions and opens the IdP grants page.
acceptance: IdP approvals and batch links no longer appear in the decision list; uncertain batches remain a Pods decision without an IdP link.
An Approvals entry with the count opens https://id.openape.ai/grants; it is hidden at zero and shows a hint when the count is unknown.
Pods sends no push of its own for grants; the IdP keeps notifying about new grants.

milestones.title: Release and verify
milestones.goal: Roll out relay first, then the signed desktop, and verify on the owner's iPhone.
acceptance: Relay deployed and healthy; signed desktop installed with a paired backup.
Both dead batch items are gone; the renewed batches wait at the IdP; the Approvals entry count matches apes grants inbox.
Evidence is published as a Test Run.
milestones.rollback: Restore the paired backup and the previous relay image.

decisions.title: Count all pending grants
decisions.description: The badge counts every grant waiting for the owner at the IdP, including requests from CLI agents outside Pods.
decisions.reference: Owner choice on October 11, 2026: "Alle offenen am IdP".

decisions.title: One growing batch per gate
decisions.description: Replaces the quiet window of issue 1449: items join one open batch for up to seven days and up to 100 items; an expired batch reopens only when nothing was released or consumed.
decisions.reference: Owner on October 11, 2026: "Automatisch neu anfragen" and "Es wäre eine große Hilfe wenn ein pod seine sammelfreigabe immer weiter erweitern könnte."

risks.title: The badge is stale on the phone
risks.mitigation: iOS updates the icon badge only on a push or when the app opens; the count refreshes on every desktop publication and every inbox push.

risks.title: An ignored batch is renewed again and again
risks.mitigation: Each renewal only replaces the expired request at the IdP; nothing runs without approval, and the count shows the batch once.

risks.title: Items wait for days before they run
risks.mitigation: Approving the batch earlier releases what is there; for mail, the archive member must treat a message that is already gone as done, which the rollout verifies.
